correctness.rationale: A direct symbolic adjacent-row subtraction establishes DQ=HD, and D maps all n-state functions onto all (n-1)-edge gradients. Rational functional calculus gives DT_h=(2R_h-I)D. Irreducible Metzler edge matrix H has a strictly positive resolvent for h>0, and is diagonally similar to a symmetric negative-definite matrix because its spectrum consists of the nonzero eigenvalues of irreducible reversible Q. Each R_h diagonal is sum_j u_ij^2/(1+h nu_j/2), strictly decreasing from one to zero. Thus all increasing gradients are preserved iff every diagonal is >=1/2, each has a unique crossing, proving exact all-rate cutoff. Direct 2x2 inversion yields displayed three-state expression. Independent Sympy exact arithmetic recreated both Q1 and Q2 CN transition matrices, both edge propagators, cutoff 2/sqrt3 and 2/sqrt7, and exact opposite ordering/nonnegative-entry witnesses. This algebraic check supports but does not replace all-dimension spectral proof.

value.rationale: For ordered Markov chains, preserving order between initial-state distributions is a distinct physical and numerical requirement from keeping rows stochastic. The theorem gives an exact sharp stability frontier across every finite nonuniform birth–death generator, not a methodwide sufficient CFL heuristic; the two opposing three-state examples show why checking one property cannot substitute for the other. Both are naturally needed to select safe numerical time steps.

final_claim: For any finite irreducible birth–death Q on ordered states, Crank–Nicolson T_h preserves all nondecreasing test functions iff h <= min_i h_i, where h_i is the unique half-return crossing ((I-h_i H/2)^(-1))_ii=1/2 of the adjacent-difference edge generator H; three states have explicit cutoff 4/(|a-d|+sqrt((a+d)^2-4bc)), with two opposite separations from entrywise Markov positivity.
limitations: Finite irreducible nearest-neighbor birth–death chains with positive existing edge rates; exact arithmetic.
Threshold for order cone alone; a true stochastic monotone kernel also requires Markov-entry positivity.
